acceptance_criteria.description: Every path selected by the repository format:check script is rewritten only by the pinned Prettier formatter.

closed_decisions: This is a deterministic formatting-only gate; no manual semantic edits, generated artifacts, documentation, Git operations, or out-of-list paths are allowed.
The authoritative path set is exactly the argument list in package.json scripts.format:check.

commands.implementation: Run the repository-pinned Prettier with --write against exactly the paths in scripts.format:check.
